# Spin-offs and demergers — NiftyTotalMarket

*Run 2025-03-31 · filings window 2024-03-01 → 2025-03-31 · 3820 restructuring filings across 546 companies · 30 confirmed demergers, 92 probable, 33 indicated, 579 rights / preferential offerings, 646 other restructurings · judge: claude-opus-5 read the schemes, three years of calls and the segment pages.*

**The method, in one paragraph.** Spin-offs are where the notes say the bargains hide: the new stock is sold by holders who never chose it for about a year, the parent is often the better buy before the split, insiders tell you what they think through the stock and options they take in the new entity, and a pro-forma statement plus the peer P/E prices what the market is ignoring. This report puts the CONFIRMED demergers first — a demerger scheme on the exchange record — each with when the new entity lists, why management is doing it (three years of calls, with the transcript each point came from), the parent's last three years with charts, P/E and cash flows, and the separated business's own numbers from the annual reports and presentations, page-cited. Probable and indicated cases follow, then every other restructuring on file.

# Confirmed demergers — in full

## VEDL — Vedanta Ltd.

**CONFIRMED** (a demerger scheme is on the exchange record) · **PRE-SPIN — study the parent; the pieces do not trade yet** · score 7.1/10 · spin-off · 33 filing(s) from CALLS, NSE · first 2024-07-17, latest 2025-03-28

> **Listing:** NOT YET — scheme at 'nclt_sanction' stage; Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited will list only after NCLT sanction, effectiveness and a record date; indicated timeline: Management said on August 6, 2024 the demerger "will get done on or before 31st of March 2025" and "has the ability to get listed as and when we have the approval"; on March 28, 2025 the Board extended the timeline for fulfilment of conditions precedent "from March 31, 2025 to September 30, 2025"

**The stages, as filed:** exchange_noc (2024-07-31) → meetings (2025-01-17) → nclt_sanction (2024-11-22)

**Stated in the filings:** resulting company **Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited**; demerged undertaking: s viz. Aluminium Undertaking (as defined under the Scheme), the Merchant Power; size hint: 7% of profit.

**What is being separated, as the documents put it:** Aluminium, merchant power, oil & gas and iron ore undertakings of Vedanta Limited, demerged into four separate resulting companies — class `value_unlocking`.

- *Insiders:* Promoter and promoter group held 2,204,867,749 shares, voting 100% in favour. Every shareholder gets 1 share of each new company; "Other than this, there will be no change in the overall shareholding structure."
- *What it reveals:* Four pure-play entities each with "$100 billion" potential; residual Vedanta keeps 63.4% of Hindustan Zinc, Zinc International and technology businesses as group incubator. Lenders preferred Base Metals retained for "optimal balancing of debt allocation". NCLT found TSPL concealed Rs 1,251 crore SEPCO dues, possibly negative post-demerger net worth.
- *Selling pressure:* likely — Shareholders get one share of each of four companies in distinct industries "capable of attracting a different set of investors"
- *Parent or spin:* — · *option pricing date:* not stated
- *Read next:* The Scheme's clause 39 conditions and debt-allocation/net-worth figures per resulting company; status of TSPL's appeal against the March 4, 2025 rejection
- *In their words:* “I envision that each of the four newly demerged companies has the potential to grow into a $100 billion company.”

### Why the demerger — three years of calls and the scheme

Mechanical read only (judge not run). Stated reasons: value unlocking for shareholders — “…y will soon file the application with Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal to progress its pursuit towards unlocking value for shareholders . ## ABFRL — Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd.

**CONFIRMED** (a demerger scheme is on the exchange record) · **SPINNING — record date set; the new entity lists soon** · score 6.4/10 · spin-off · 56 filing(s) from CALLS, NSE · first 2024-04-01, latest 2025-03-27

> **Listing:** RECORD DATE set; Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited not yet listed — resulting companies have typically listed 4–10 weeks after the record date; filings/calls say: Jan 15, 2025 press release: 'The demerger exercise is expected to be completed by the end of this financial year.' Feb 17, 2025 call: demerger 'is progressing well and set for completion within the next 2, 3 months. The NCLT hearing is scheduled in third week of March 2025.' NCLT sanctioned the Scheme March 27, 2025; actual listing date not stated.

**The stages, as filed:** announced (2024-04-19) → exchange_noc (2024-10-30) → meetings (2025-01-21) → nclt_sanction (2024-04-30) → effective (2025-02-14)

**Stated in the filings:** resulting company **Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited**; entitlement **11 for every 6**; size hint: 8% of revenue.

**What is being separated, as the documents put it:** Madura Fashion & Lifestyle (MFL) western wear brands business, demerged into Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited — class `value_unlocking`.

- *Insiders:* All demerged-company shareholders get identical shareholdings in both companies. Promoter group entity Pilani subscribed Rs 1,297.50 crore preferential issue at Rs 317.75, a ~18% premium; ESOPs replaced with ABLBL options adjusted for share exchange ratio.
- *What it reveals:* MFL is the proven, cash-generating half: Rs 5,925 crore 9M revenue, 16.5% Q3 EBITDA margin, 'consistent revenue growth, profitability, strong free cash flows and high return on capital', starting with only Rs 700 crore debt, while remaining ABFRL's Ethnic and Others segment lost Rs 368 crore.
- *Selling pressure:* unlikely — Spun entity is roughly half of group revenue and the profitable cash generator; all shareholders receive identical holdings in both companies.
- *Parent or spin:* spin · *option pricing date:* not stated
- *Read next:* Certified NCLT order filing, record date and ABLBL listing intimation; plus ABLBL opening balance sheet (Rs 700 crore debt).
- *In their words:* “The distinctive profile and established business model of the MFL Business makes it suitable to be housed in a separately listed entity, allowing sharper strategic focus in pursuit of its independent value creation trajectory.”

## ADANIENT — Adani Enterprises Ltd.

**CONFIRMED** (a demerger scheme is on the exchange record) · **PRE-SPIN — study the parent; the pieces do not trade yet** · score 6.4/10 · spin-off · 5 filing(s) from NSE · first 2024-08-01, latest 2024-11-14

> **Listing:** NOT YET — scheme at 'announced' stage; Adani Wilmar Limited will list only after NCLT sanction, effectiveness and a record date; indicated timeline: Stated 1 August 2024: "Yes. The Resulting Company New Equity Shares shall be listed on BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited, where the existing Equity Shares of Resulting Company are listed." On January 30, 2025 management said instead an option agreement was signed and 13.5% sold via OFS, with the remaining 30.4% to be transferred per the agreement, subject to antitrust/competition approvals taking roughly 6 to 30 weeks.

**Stated in the filings:** resulting company **Adani Wilmar Limited**; demerged undertaking: Food FMCG Business of the Demerged Company; size hint: 10.47% of ebitda.

**What is being separated, as the documents put it:** Food FMCG division — trading and supply of edible oil and allied commodities, plus strategic investments in Adani Commodities LLP — class `value_unlocking`.

- *Insiders:* Shareholders including promoter/promoter group of AEL will hold Resulting Company shares directly; Adani Wilmar promoters fall 87.87% to 76.76%, public rises 12.13% to 23.24%; no change in AEL's pattern.
- *What it reveals:* Turnover of the demerged undertaking as on 31 March 2024 was Nil; Adani Wilmar contributed only ~INR 250 crores cash after tax to AEL, while post-tax equity proceeds of ~INR 14,200 crores can fund ~INR 70,000 crores of core infra at 15-18% returns.
- *Selling pressure:* likely — Adani Wilmar's public float nearly doubles (12.13% to 23.24%); AEL holders receive 251 edible-oil FMCG shares per 500, unrelated to AEL's infra businesses.
- *Parent or spin:* parent · *option pricing date:* not stated (option agreement with respect to the Adani Wilmar JV said to be agreed 'during the quarter' ended 31 December 2024, disclosed on the January 30, 2025 call)
- *Read next:* The Proposed Scheme with RBSA Valuation Advisors' report and Vivro fairness opinion; plus Adani Wilmar's own consolidated financials, since undertaking turnover was Nil.
- *In their words:* “It is believed that the proposed demerger will unlock the direct value of the Demerged Company's shareholders into the Resulting Company and allow a focused strategy and specialization for sustained growth for enhanced value, which would be in the best interest of all the stakeholders and the persons connected with the aforesaid companies.”

## QUESS — Quess Corp Ltd.

**CONFIRMED** (a demerger scheme is on the exchange record) · **SPINNING — record date set; the new entity lists soon** · score 5.7/10 · spin-off · 40 filing(s) from CALLS, NSE · first 2024-05-09, latest 2025-03-31

> **Listing:** RECORD DATE 2025-04-15; Digitide Solutions Limited not yet listed — resulting companies have typically listed 4–10 weeks after the record date; filings/calls say: Investor presentation dated January 29, 2025 shows "Q1 FY26 — Application with Stock Exchanges, Corporate Actions with NSDL/CDSL – Listing and trading on stock exchanges" and "target demerger by Q1FY26"; on January 30, 2025 CFO said "we should be able to see all 3 companies demerged and listed by Q1 of next financial year". Scheme became effective March 31, 2025 (appointed date April 1, 2024), with record date "to be informed in due course" per March 18, 2025 letter.

**The stages, as filed:** exchange_noc (2024-08-01) → meetings (2024-09-20) → nclt_sanction (2024-10-24) → effective (2025-03-31) → record_date (2025-04-15)

**Stated in the filings:** resulting company **Digitide Solutions Limited**; demerged undertaking: 1 to Resulting Company; entitlement **1 for every 1**; record date 2025-04-15; pro-forma statements referenced; size hint: 14% of ebitda.

**What is being separated, as the documents put it:** Quess's Global Technology Solutions platform — BPM services, customer lifecycle management, HR outsourcing and InsurTech — into Digitide Solutions Limited — class `value_unlocking`.

- *Insiders:* Mirror shareholding — promoters 56.6%, public 43.4% in each entity; 1 new share per Quess share. Vested ESOPs transfer to resulting companies, unvested cancelled with fresh allotment. Gurmeet Chahal hired as CEO to lead Digitide.
- *What it reveals:* GTS is the group's margin engine: 9MFY25 revenue ₹1,881cr (12% of consolidated) but EBITDA ₹327cr of ₹581cr at 17.4% margin versus 3.7% consolidated. FY24 revenue ₹2.3k cr, EBITDA ₹425cr, 17% revenue CAGR FY21-24, rising international mix.
- *Selling pressure:* likely — Small unlisted entity distributed 1:1 to 99,413 shareholders; BPM/tech business unrelated to parent's workforce-management staffing franchise.
- *Parent or spin:* spin · *option pricing date:* not stated
- *Read next:* Digitide's Information Memorandum / abridged-prospectus disclosures required by BSE-NSE observation letters — standalone assets, liabilities, net worth, revenue.
- *In their words:* “Digitide Solutions (Resulting Company- 1), will offer a comprehensive suite of solutions including BPM Services, Insurtech and HRO.”

## Rights and preferential offerings — who is buying

A rights issue hands the paper to existing holders; a preferential issue of equity or warrants hands it to named buyers at a fixed price. The notes' question is the same for both: are the insiders putting money in? Promoters taking warrants (25% upfront, 18 months to convert) is insiders betting on the stock; paper placed with outsiders is dilution. Each row names the buyers the filings name.

## How this was built

- **Filings:** NSE's corporate-announcements feed read month by month for the 2024-03-01 → 2025-03-31 window and filtered to the 752 official NiftyTotalMarket constituents; BSE via its daily RSS (accumulating) and the BSE-sourced per-company lists on screener.in. Each filing is classified by category and headline, its attachment reduced to text and re-classified from the text. Stored in `IndividualStockAnalysis/India/Announcements/NiftyTotalMarket/`.
- **Confidence:** confirmed = a Demerger / Scheme filing or a scheme text that demerges is on the exchange record; probable = a subsidiary listing in motion or a scheme whose nature the documents do not settle; indicated = news verification, denial or calls alone.
- **Listing:** from the record date and listing filings; where neither exists, what the filings and calls say about timing, or that nothing is stated. The 4–10 week note is the typical gap between record date and listing seen in these filings, not a forecast.
- **Rationale:** every passage in the last 36 months of the stored calls where the separation was discussed, plus the scheme's rationale section, read by the judge; each point links to its transcript. Transcripts and presentations are indexed in `InvestorPresentations/NiftyTotalMarket/_concall_links.csv`.
- **Parent numbers:** the stored consolidated P&L and cash-flow statements (screener.in); growth and margins computed here. P/E from the live Nifty 500 market file, else latest stored close ÷ latest fiscal-year EPS. Charts are Mermaid xychart blocks (render on GitHub).
- **Segment numbers:** the last three annual reports and twelve quarterly presentations (`AnnualReports/`, `InvestorPresentations/`, page-marked text), their segment-reporting pages read by the judge with document and page per number; growth and margins computed here. Where the pages do not carry the figures, the report says so.
- **Judge:** claude-opus-5 read the schemes, three years of calls and the segment pages; reads only the documents shown to it, must quote, cached per document hash and model.
- **Score:** share of checklist items answered yes (1) or partly (½), on 10 — visibility of the pattern in the documents, not stock quality.
- **Coverage:** `_coverage.csv` lists, per highlighted company, which of the above was found and which was not.
